title: Garlicky Pav Bhaji
description: A popular Indian street food dish made with a flavorful mixture of vegetables and pav bread.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the diced tomatoes until they're soft and fragrant.
Add the cumin, coriander, and turmeric to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of water to the pan and bring it to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer the mixture for 10-15 minutes or until it thickens.
Stir in the lightly toasted pav bread to soak up the flavorful mixture.
Serve the garlicky pav bhaji hot with a dollop of butter on top.
